text.en: This Act may be cited as the Buffaloes Act.
In this Act and in any rules made thereunder unless Interpretathe context otherwise requires-tion "buffalo" includes cattle; means bulls, cows, oxen, heifers and calves.

(1) It shall be the duty of the owner of any savage Savage buffalo to destroy the same forthwith. (2} If such owner neglect to do so any person may report the matter to a police officer who may destroy such buffalo if he shall find the same to be dangerous.

heading.en: Liability for damage done by buffaloes

text.en: The owner or person in charge of a buffalo shall be Liability for liable for all damage done by such buffalo which may arise damage done such buffalo not being properly folded, tethered or otherwise kept under control, and may also be charged before the nearest magistrate for permitting the buffalo to stray and, on conviction, shall be liable to a fine of $500, or, of payment, imprisonment for 6 weeks.

(1) It shall be lawful for His Majesty in Council from time to time to make and publish rules not inconsistent with may make the general purposes of this Act and when made cancel, vary or extend the same.

(2) Such rules may provide among other things for

(a) the imposition and collection of inspection and slaughtering fees; _.·

(b) the control of the slaughter of cattle;

(c) the fixing of penalties for contraventions of any rules made under this Act.
